notes: §2002:14.8.26.3 GR25: with EC-I-O checking on, the format 3 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION EC-I-O FILE procedure of a failed OPEN already sees the I-O status (35, then 41) and the EC-I-O condition (EC-I-O-PERMANENT-ERROR, EC-I-O-LOGIC-ERROR), so a) and b) precede c); the absent file is not created and the already-open file keeps its records and open mode. Matched at --std 2002. The run continues after RESUME by §2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 2, which applies because the format 3 USE names EC-I-O.
